about: The voice cast: which ElevenLabs voice plays each role, and how voice.py processes its takes. Chosen in spike S5 (2026-11-08) by measuring auditions against the reference voices (docs/VOICE.md). Voice ids come from the connector's voice list; swap a role's voice here and every later line uses it.

narrator.name: Liam
narrator.for: family A's on-screen narrator: setups, rants, retorts
narrator.tags: [excited] for setups, [sarcastic] or [deadpan] for retorts, [shouting] for outbursts
narrator.measured: audition 214 Hz median, 3.5 words a second after 1.12x; the references' narrators 191-247 Hz; a sarcastic retort read 149 Hz, so the range is wide: it catches a wrong voice, not a mood

girl.name: Yuria
girl.for: teen girls' lines: the popular girl, the teacher's pet, a sister
girl.measured: audition 339 Hz; the references' girls about 320 Hz

girl_bratty.name: Kathie
girl_bratty.for: a spoiled, sassier girl when two girls talk

deep.name: Adam
deep.for: one-word or short deadpan punches, in-world notices read aloud
deep.measured: audition 82 Hz; the references' deep punches 79-123 Hz

story.name: Liam
story.for: family B's storyteller, reading everything, characters' lines included
story.tags: [urgent] to open, [softly] or [slowly] for the twist's last line
story.measured: audition 183 Hz, 4.8 words a second in one sentence at 1.2x; the references' storytellers 173-233 Hz, 4.1-4.7 words a second over whole stories

mom.name: Lyra
mom.for: a mom or another adult woman (the references mostly keep moms in the narrator's voice)
mom.measured: audition 419 Hz when bubbly; untested as a mom
